source_caption_text:
Playboi Carti had absolutely no idea what Big Boy was talking about 💀

This interview moment between Playboi Carti and Big Boy will never not be funny. Big Boy asked Carti about his relationship with “MC Scratch,” and Carti had absolutely no idea who he was talking about.

Carti kept asking who MC Scratch was, looking genuinely confused while Big Boy tried to get him to understand. The best part was when Big Boy finally revealed that MC Scratch was his old name before he became Big Boy.

Carti’s reaction made the whole thing even funnier. He wasn’t even trying to be disrespectful, he genuinely didn’t know, and once Big Boy explained it, Carti admitted the name was pretty wild.

Via @bigboy
